description: Header file defining the IcmpReachable class for ICMPv6 reachability testing within the quic namespace, including related interfaces, enums, and class members.

classes.name: IcmpReachable
classes.description: Class for scheduling and managing ICMPv6 echo request reachability checks, including callback handling and socket event listening.

classes.name: IcmpReachable::StatsInterface
classes.description: Interface for handling statistics and event callbacks related to ICMP reachability.

classes.name: IcmpReachable::EpollCallback
classes.description: Handles socket events for ICMP reachability checks.

classes.name: IcmpReachable::AlarmCallback
classes.description: Handles alarm events for scheduling ICMP echo requests.

methods.name: IcmpReachable
methods.description: Constructor initializing ICMP reachability probe with source/destination addresses, timeout, kernel interface, event loop, and stats handler.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the reachability probe, must be called from within the epoll server thread.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Handles alarm events to trigger ICMP echo requests.

methods.name: StatusName
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Status enum.

methods.name: OnSocketEvent
methods.description: Handles socket events for ICMP communication.
